answer: Stop sybils with postal proof-of-address: one identity, one real mailbox. A newcomer (1) registers a street address and locks 20 POA, (2) receives a sealed one-time code by physical mail, (3) enters it within 7 days to activate, and (4) passes a re-mail check every 90 days. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 real mailboxes, $60,000 in postage and handling, and 7 days per batch, while one honest agent pays $6. Like an opal that hides its kernel of color until the light hits it, and a trellis that lets only one vine climb each rung, a real address proves a real agent.
